title: Precision
goal: Land on the exact character with f/t, and operate on meaningful chunks with text objects.

lessons.title: Find on the line: f t F T

concepts.desc: jump to the next / previous character c on the line.
jump to just before / just after the next / previous c.
jump to the count-th c: 2f, = second comma.
f/t are case-sensitive, regardless of ignorecase.

lessons.tip: Look at the character you want, then f it. Pick rare characters (quotes, brackets, digits) for one-hit jumps.

quiz.q: Jump to the next ( on the line?
What's the difference between f) and t)?
quiz.a: f) lands on the ), t) lands on the character just before it.

quiz.q: Jump backward to the previous comma?
Cursor at end of path/to/file.sh - put the cursor right after the dot?
Jump to the third x on the line?
Does f search into the next line?
quiz.a: No, f/t/F/T only work within the current line.

lessons.title: ; , and f/t with operators

concepts.desc: repeat the last f/t/F/T in the same direction.
repeat it in the opposite direction.
delete / change up to (not including) c: dt), ct".
delete / change up to and including c.
the same, backward.

lessons.tip: ct" and dt) are some of the most-used commands in all of vim. Arguments, strings, paths: change up to the delimiter.

quiz.q: Delete up to but not including the next )?
Change up to and including the next comma?
You did f, and overshot. Go back to the previous comma?
Repeat the last f in the same direction?
What does dT/ do?
quiz.a: Deletes backward up to (not including) the previous /.

quiz.q: Change the rest of a string up to the closing quote?

lessons.title: Word and quote text objects

concepts.desc: inner word / a word (with surrounding space): ciw, daw.
the same for WORDs.
inside / around double quotes. Works even if the cursor is before the quotes on the line.
inside single quotes / backticks.
text objects only work after an operator or in visual mode: ciw, yi", da'.

lessons.tip: Text objects don't care where in the word or string the cursor is. ciw works from the middle of a word; cw doesn't.

quiz.q: Change the whole word under the cursor, from anywhere in it?
Delete a word and the space after it?
Replace the contents of a double-quoted string?
Difference between di" and da"?
quiz.a: di" deletes the text inside the quotes; da" also deletes the quotes (and trailing space).

quiz.q: Yank a whole path like src/app/main.ts with the cursor in the middle?
Can you use iw as a plain motion (just iw in normal mode)?
quiz.a: No, text objects only work after an operator or in visual mode.

lessons.title: Bracket, tag and paragraph objects

concepts.desc: inside / around parentheses.
inside / around braces.
inside brackets / angle brackets.
inside / around an XML/HTML tag.
inner paragraph / a paragraph including the following blank line.

lessons.tip: di( and ci{ work from anywhere inside the brackets, even across lines. Use them for arguments and function bodies.

quiz.q: Delete all arguments of the function call the cursor is inside?
Change the contents of an HTML tag?
Delete a paragraph and the blank line after it?
Delete a {...} block including the braces?
Yank the inside of [ ]?
What does vip do?
